newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Rothmans Ind expects weaker second half.
newsitem.headline: Rothmans Ind expects weaker second half.

text.p: Rothmans Industries Ltd said on Friday it expects its second half performance to be weaker than that in the first half.
In a note accompanying its results for the first half ended September 30, Rothmans said the year-on-year gain seen in Singapore sales was unlikely to continue.

Consumer sales were expected to decline due to continued anti-smoking pressures, it said. It added growth in overseas operations might not be sustainable given the volatility associated with some of its key markets.

The group posted a 36 percent rise in net profit to Singapore $24.78 million in the first half.
